name: f5-geometric-curvature-graph
description: Renders two of this folder's own figures for one study, as a standalone HTML page: section 9.1's 'three graphic depths parametrized by CDI' and section 9.3's Gaussian dip curve, over the same real CDI population and the same three representative persons. Reads GDX_HNF_CDI_VALUE/GDX_HNF_CDIH_VALUE directly and applies the graphic gains and sigma live, at render time -- never requires or reads a pre-existing GDX_HNF_VISDEPTH_RUN/GDX_HNF_DEPTHCURVE_RUN, and never computes or displays a true Riemannian scalar curvature.
